articles.title: Japan records a trade deficit for 4th month as oil imports soar
articles.description: Japan’s trade deficit totaled $7 billion last month, as surging oil prices sent the cost of imports soaring. The Finance Ministry’s preliminary data released Wednesday showed the fourth straight month of such red ink. Resource-poor Japan imports virtually all its oil. Previously that came mostly through the Strait of Hormuz, which remains effectively closed due to conflicts in the Middle East. Japan’s imports in August rose 28% from the same month a year ago to $71.9 billion. Exports rose 19.3% to $64.5 billion, mainly in computer chips and autos.

articles.title: Gold prices under pressure ahead of Fed rate decision
articles.description: On Wednesday, gold prices were uninspired as traders held their breath for the Federal Reserve's anticipated policy announcement. A widely expected interest rate hike is on the horizon, which typically diminishes the allure of non-yielding gold. Additionally, ongoing geopolitical issues in the Middle East and fluctuations in oil prices add layers of complexity to market sentiment. Traders are closely analyzing the Fed's rhetoric to divine potential market shifts.
